rationale: Branded operational tables contain overlapping subtotals and program partitions. A usable attribution must preserve their hierarchy, billion/million unit conversion and rounding. Company revenue has wider scope, so purchase-size changes cannot be read as network pricing or independently separated merchant price and mix effects.
exposure: Reference/control verification only, no candidate-model exposure
reference_method: Independent Python Decimal calculations from source facts, separate from submitted SQL
candidate_view_review: Source headings, signs, periods and relevant definitions directly inspected before model exposure

contract_revision.changes: Explicit input database, output directory and existing basename restriction

grading_correction.changes: Correct SBC source bindings and accept known dossier context with sufficient support. No financial, source, SQL or counterfactual changes.

quality_revision.evidence: Reviewed per-output support and additional context, unrelated sections rejected

replacement_review.assertion: Higher merchant prices caused more than half of the FY2025 increase in average value per Mastercard-branded purchase transaction.
replacement_review.source_grounded_reason: Branded purchase value and transaction counts identify average transaction size. They do not decompose merchant prices, goods per basket, geography or customer mix, so they cannot establish this causal majority.
